Privacy Policy

Last Updated: February 21, 2026

1. Introduction

Koko Maya Resort ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share information about you when you visit our website or use our services.

2. Information We Collect

We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you make a room reservation, sign up for our newsletter, or contact us with an enquiry. This may include:

  • Name and contact information (email, phone number, address)
  • Payment information (processed securely via our partners)
  • Booking details (dates, number of guests)
  • Government-issued ID details (required at check-in)

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Process and confirm your reservations.
  • Communicate with you about your stay or enquiries.
  • Send you promotional offers and newsletters (if opted in).
  • Improve our website and guest services.
  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements in India.

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with:

  • Our booking engine partner (eZee Technosys) to process reservations.
  • Service providers who assist with payment processing or marketing.
  • Law enforcement or government authorities when required by law.

5. Your Choices

You may opt out of receiving promotional emails from us by following the instructions in those emails. You can also request to update or delete your personal information by contacting us.

6. Cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience on our website. You can manage your cookie preferences through our on-site cookie banner or your browser settings.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at hello@kokomaya.com.
